claim_ceiling: TF-IDF family representations at 174k scale show strong citation heritage signal (AUC 0.72-0.97) and pass adversarial language dominance, but fail hierarchy coherence, legal area clustering, branch classification, and temporal stability. Full-text representations capture metadata/branch structure but are dominated by language artifacts. Label normalization improves citation-based hierarchy clustering but degrades full-text zoom coherence.
evidence_summary: Formal suite: 8 representations x 12 benchmarks = 96 evaluations with frozen thresholds; honest FAIL/PASS/skip reporting. Citation pairs: 8,175 positive pairs regenerated; all pairs differ from prior; same count; random sampling non-determinism confirmed in generator. v17b label normalization: 7 representations x 3 metrics x raw/normalized = 42 data points; identical to prior run. Config hash 4323f833fa72366a consistent across all formal suite results. No metric manipulation, no leakage (exact k-NN on held-out subsample), negative results preserved without spin.
